name: Myanmar
value: Civil war; no major city changed hands
summary: Junta airstrikes across Rakhine as the Arakan Army presses Sittwe; no major city falls
state: Junta aircraft carried out airstrikes across Rakhine State overnight on 1–2 Nov, according to Arakan groups, while the Arakan Army keeps Sittwe and Kyaukphyu encircled (BNI). Junta airstrikes aim to push the AA toward talks (Eurasia Review, 5 Oct). No major city had changed hands as of 4 Nov.
for_you: FCDO advises against travel to much of Myanmar. Civilians in Rakhine face airstrikes and supply shortages.
